profile.name: GenICam工业相机
profile.description: 符合 GenICam/GenTL 标准的工业相机或成像设备，用于实验室中的图像采集、机器视觉、显微成像和自动化检测。此类设备通常可被枚举、连接，并持续输出二维图像数据流。
profile.description_en: A GenICam/GenTL-compatible machine vision camera or imaging device used in laboratories for image acquisition, machine vision, microscopy, and automated inspection. Such devices can typically be enumerated, connected, and used to stream 2D image data.
